data.title: 冬马和纱 · 车站里的琴谱箱
data.description: 车站人来人往。和纱站在行李箱旁，确认夹在手里的琴谱没有落下。
data.action: standing beside a suitcase and holding sheet music
data.promptProse: Standing beside a battered leather suitcase and a hard piano score case on a deserted railway platform at dawn, Kazusa double-checks a sheaf of handwritten sheet music. Chilly morning mist curls along the railway tracks, while distant platform signals in red and green reflect against the frosted platform roof and her long raven ponytail.
